_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP10 Q1 (+Q2 from its record). LANE ONLY, x2 consecutive on one lane, never retuned. Preconditions: the DEV bundle (npm run build:dev; the probe storyOrchestratorToolTurnProbe is __SO_DEV__), a Chat Completion profile selected with /profile per the v2.4 plan 06 recipe (llama-server needs Additional Parameters chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking: false}), and a run header captured first. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes <n> --repeat 2 --strict --group <lane group id> test/scenarios/v25-09-tool-turn.json. It registers one dummy tool (so_sp10_roll) and makes it MANDATORY by forcing tool_choice 'required' on every chat-completions request whose messages carry no tool result after the last user message (the continuation stays on auto). Ten player turns through send_generate; the probe records, per player turn and per drafted member, generations, tool calls, rendered replies, boundaries and the per-generation entry points. A player turn with no tool call means the backend ignored the forced choice: the run fails as 'measured nothing'. The record is kept in localStorage so-sp10-q1 and printed by the measuring step; copy it into docs/plans/v2.5/09-sp10-spike-report.md. The last step unregisters the tool, restores fetch and chatCompletionSettings.function_calling (in memory; nothing here saves settings). After a FAILED run: reload the page, then diff the run header.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.mainApi !== 'openai') throw new Error(`SP10 needs a Chat Completion main API; mainApi is ${ctx.mainApi}`); const probe = globalThis.storyOrchestratorToolTurnProbe; if (!probe) throw new Error('storyOrchestratorToolTurnProbe is missing: SP10 needs the dev bundle (npm run build:dev)'); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((name) => name.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const original = globalThis.fetch; const forced = []; globalThis.__sp10 = { original, forced, functionCalling: ctx.chatCompletionSettings.function_calling }; ctx.chatCompletionSettings.function_calling = true; ctx.registerFunctionTool({ name: 'so_sp10_roll', displayName: 'SP10 roll', description: 'Roll the scene die. Call it before every reply.', parameters: { $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#', type: 'object', properties: { reason: { type: 'string', description: 'Why the die is rolled.' } }, required: ['reason'] }, action: async () => 'The die shows 4.', formatMessage: () => 'Rolling the scene die.' }); globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''; if (url.includes('/api/backends/chat-completions/generate') && typeof init?.body === 'string') { const body = JSON.parse(init.body); const messages = Array.isArray(body.messages) ? body.messages : []; const lastUser = messages.map((message) => message?.role).lastIndexOf('user'); const answered = messages.slice(lastUser + 1).some((message) => message?.role === 'tool'); if (Array.isArray(body.tools) && body.tools.length && !answered) { body.tool_choice = 'required'; forced.push(Date.now()); init = { ...init, body: JSON.stringify(body) }; } } return original(input, init); }; probe.start(); return { mainApi: ctx.mainApi, supported: ctx.isToolCallingSupported() };

send_generate.text: I look around the yard for anything out of place.
I ask Arin what she heard last night.
I pick up the torn map and read it aloud.
Ponticius, what does the guild want with this map?
I follow the cart tracks toward the gate.
I knock on the gatehouse door.
We wait for an answer, then try the latch.
I light a lantern and step inside.
I tell the others to stay close and keep watch.

steps.eval: const probe = globalThis.storyOrchestratorToolTurnProbe; const state = globalThis.__sp10; const report = probe.read(); if (report.turns.length !== 10) throw new Error(`expected 10 player turns, the probe saw ${report.turns.length}`); const silent = report.turns.filter((turn) => turn.toolCalls === 0).map((turn) => turn.userMessageId); if (silent.length) throw new Error(`no tool call in the player turn(s) at message ${silent.join(', ')}: the mandatory tool was not honoured, so Q1 measured nothing`); const record = { at: new Date().toISOString(), forcedRequests: state.forced.length, summary: report.summary, turns: report.turns }; localStorage.setItem('so-sp10-q1', JSON.stringify(record)); return record;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const state = globalThis.__sp10; globalThis.storyOrchestratorToolTurnProbe?.stop(); ctx.unregisterFunctionTool('so_sp10_roll'); if (state) { globalThis.fetch = state.original; ctx.chatCompletionSettings.function_calling = state.functionCalling; } delete globalThis.__sp10; return { restored: Boolean(state) };
